$comment: Local extension: upstream SAP abap-file-formats has no UCON RFC service (SRFC) format. Field names map to UCONRFCSERVHEAD (scope, function module, default profile) and UCONRFCSERVTEXT (short text); the ICF /srfc/<name> wire document mirrors this shape.
title: UCON RFC Service Properties
description: UCON RFC service (SRFC): an RFC-enabled function module exposed through Unified Connectivity

description.title: Description
description.description: Short text of the RFC service (UCONRFCSERVTEXT-SHORTTEXT, CHAR 255, single line). Language-dependent: the CLI reads and writes the session language.

functionName.title: Function Module
functionName.description: RFC-enabled function module backing the service (UCONRFCSERVHEAD-FUNCNAME, CHAR 30). Must exist and be RFC-enabled.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Call scope of the service (UCONRFCSCOPE domain). O = obsolete function, should not be called; E = callable from other systems; P = not callable from outside the client or system; S = callable from own system only (all clients).
enumTitles: Not callable from outside the client or system

defaultProfile.title: Default Profile
defaultProfile.description: UCON profile assigned to the service (UCONRFCSERVHEAD-DEFAULT_PROFILE, CHAR 30). Must exist in UCONPROFHEAD when set.
